name: Healthcare Practice Management: Apply Practice Manager message decision
description: Applies the reviewer's decision on a Practice Manager message approval form (cancellation reschedule offers and payment follow-ups): sends the (possibly edited) message through Microsoft 365, or leaves the item open with instructions when the practice uses Gmail (no send tool yet) or there's no email on file. For a reschedule offer, keeps the item open and hands it to the reply reader, which books the time the patient picks.

nodes.title: Apply message decision
nodes.summary: Sends the approved message (or records why it wasn't sent) and, for reschedule offers, starts waiting for the patient's reply.

outputs.name: outcome
outputs.description: sent, sent_awaiting_reply, needs_manual_send, send_failed, not_sent, no_email, draft_missing or ignored.
